basics.name: Nguyen Thi Thuy Linh
basics.label: Backend developer & researcher
basics.summary: Backend developer and researcher specializing in cloud computing, microservices, and security. Passionate about designing scalable, secure distributed systems and bridging research and industry to advance secure and resilient architectures.

work.name: University of Trento
work.summary: Research at the Security Laboratory focusing on microservice security, verifiable computation, and hands-on CTF/Kubernetes challenges for students.
highlights: Collect, set up, and deploy CTF challenges on Kubernetes for UniTrento students.
Surveyed microservice security (attacks, data protection, eBPF, AI-based solutions) from 2019 to 2025.
Research on verifiable computation in microservices using blockchain and ZKPs.

work.name: Softfreak
work.summary: Built API Management Security project and integrated it with MyData; designed backend/frontend architecture and data collection/analysis agents.
highlights: Started API Management Security project and integrated it with MyData.
Developed 3 data collection agents (Nginx, eBPF, mirroring) and 4 analysis engines integrated with Kafka and databases.
Created benchmark test cases for 10,000 concurrent users using JMeter and Postman.

work.name: Soongsil University
work.summary: Research on HIDS in container environments, seccomp profile generation, and federated learning data balancing.
highlights: Published at MobiSec 2023 on HIDS contextual improvements in containers.
Implemented a Seccomp profile generator combining static and dynamic analysis (MobiSec 2022).
Applied data balancing techniques to improve Federated Learning performance (CUTE-CSA 2022).

work.name: Ginnovations
work.summary: Developed scalable backend systems and security features for messaging and IoT-like devices.
highlights: Developed MQTT security patch for a notification system serving 10,000 concurrent users.
Designed and implemented scalable E2E protocol and mobile sync apps for XOR phones.
Built monitoring system using Logstash/Kibana and implemented a secure messaging C library (ECIES).

work.name: Hanoi University of Science and Technology (HUST)
work.summary: Research assistant work related to digital signal processing and steganography leading to a conference publication.
highlights: Developed a chaos-based steganography method for medical images (thesis) and published at IEEE MAPR 2021.
